```{r setup, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}


# Load NBA dataset from local file (contains player stats across seasons)
nba = read.csv("C:/Users/mccor/Downloads/NBA STATsR.csv")

# View column names to understand available variables
names(nba)

# Rename FG. column because R imports FG% as FG.
colnames(nba)[colnames(nba) == "FG."] <- "FG_percent"

# Select only relevant variables and remove missing values
# Focus is on scoring, playing time, shot volume, and efficiency
nba <- na.omit(nba[, c("Player", "Year", "MP", "PTS", "FGA", "FG_percent")])

# Filter dataset to only include LeBron James for comparison
lebron <- subset(nba, Player == "LeBron James")

# Display LeBron's data to verify filtering worked
lebron
```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# GRAPH 1: Minutes Played vs Points
# Purpose: Show relationship between playing time and scoring
# -------------------------------
plot(nba$MP, nba$PTS,
     main = "Relationship Between Playing Time and Scoring",
     xlab = "Minutes Played per Game (MP)",
     ylab = "Points Scored per Game (PTS)")

# Highlight LeBron’s data points to compare with league trends
points(lebron$MP, lebron$PTS, pch = 19)

# Add legend to distinguish all players vs LeBron
legend("topleft",
       legend = c("All Players", "LeBron James"),
       pch = c(1, 19))
```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# GRAPH 2: Field Goal Attempts vs Points
# Purpose: Analyze impact of shot volume on scoring
# -------------------------------
plot(nba$FGA, nba$PTS,
     main = "Impact of Shot Attempts on Scoring",
     xlab = "Field Goal Attempts per Game (FGA)",
     ylab = "Points Scored per Game (PTS)")

# Highlight LeBron’s position within the relationship
points(lebron$FGA, lebron$PTS, pch = 19)

# Add legend for clarity
legend("topleft",
       legend = c("All Players", "LeBron James"),
       pch = c(1, 19))
```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# GRAPH 3: Field Goal Percentage vs Points
# Purpose: Evaluate effect of shooting efficiency on scoring
# -------------------------------
plot(nba$FG_percent, nba$PTS,
     main = "Effect of Shooting Efficiency on Scoring",
     xlab = "Field Goal Percentage (FG%)",
     ylab = "Points Scored per Game (PTS)")

# Highlight LeBron’s efficiency compared to others
points(lebron$FG_percent, lebron$PTS, pch = 19)

# Add legend to identify LeBron
legend("topleft",
       legend = c("All Players", "LeBron James"),
       pch = c(1, 19))
```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# GRAPH 4: Histogram of Points
# Purpose: Show distribution of scoring across all players
# -------------------------------
hist(nba$PTS,
     main = "Distribution of Points Among NBA Players",
     xlab = "Points per Game (PTS)",
     ylab = "Number of Players")
```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# GRAPH 5: LeBron Scoring Over Time
# Purpose: Analyze consistency of LeBron’s scoring across seasons
# -------------------------------
plot(1:nrow(lebron), lebron$PTS,
     type = "b",
     main = "LeBron James Scoring Over Time",
     xlab = "Season",
     ylab = "Points per Game (PTS)",
     xaxt = "n")

# Replace numeric x-axis with actual season labels
axis(1, at = 1:nrow(lebron), labels = lebron$Year, las = 2)
```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# STATISTICAL ANALYSIS
# -------------------------------

# Calculate league average scoring
mean(nba$PTS)

# Correlation: Minutes vs Points (relationship strength)
cor(nba$MP, nba$PTS)

# Correlation: Shot Attempts vs Points (strongest relationship)
cor(nba$FGA, nba$PTS)

# Correlation: Efficiency vs Points (weaker relationship)
cor(nba$FG_percent, nba$PTS)

# Simple linear regression model: Predict scoring using shot attempts
model_simple = lm(PTS ~ FGA, data = nba)

# Display full regression results and model strength
summary(model_simple)

# -------------------------------
# LEBRON SUMMARY STATISTICS
# -------------------------------

# Average minutes played by LeBron
mean(lebron$MP)

# Average scoring by LeBron
mean(lebron$PTS)

# Average shot attempts by LeBron
mean(lebron$FGA)

# Average shooting efficiency of LeBron
mean(lebron$FG_percent)

# Standard deviation of LeBron’s scoring (consistency measure)
sd(lebron$PTS)

# Highest scoring season in LeBron’s data
max(lebron$PTS)

# Lowest scoring season in LeBron’s data
min(lebron$PTS)

# Range of LeBron’s scoring across seasons
max(lebron$PTS) - min(lebron$PTS)
```
